# apps: add alternative for 1Password 7 - v8

Add 1Password 8 next to 1Password 7. Version 7 came from the Mac App Store (id `1333542190`, line 7 of [toolset/Apps](../../toolset/Apps) at the time); version 8 is distributed outside the store as the [`1password` cask](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/1password), and the Safari extension became a separate App Store item:

```
1333542190  1Password 7 - Password Manager                  (7.9.5)
1569813296  1Password for Safari                            (2.3.3)
```

The two had to coexist during the migration, and [Inventory.yaml](../../toolset/Inventory.yaml) needed a way to record one application with two distribution channels ([#326](DOT-325.md)).
